description: The hybridGEOTABS project publishes a set of hydraulic connection schemes for ground-source and thermally activated building HVAC concepts. The Zenodo page says the schemes address different EU climates and operation modes and show links between core system modules and auxiliary equipment. A building-energy modeller could translate a chosen scheme into a heat-pump, thermal-storage or distribution-loop topology before testing control scenarios. Zenodo lists one public PDF under CC BY 4.0; it is a schematic information source, not an executable hydraulic network model or a set of measured pipe-flow data. The landing page does not state component capacities, pipe dimensions, pressure losses or the number of alternatives. Those values must be supplied independently for quantitative simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this set of hydraulic schemes. The PDF was not downloaded, so individual diagrams and connection details were not inspected; the reuse case rests on the provider description.
name: (D6.5_dataset01) Hydraulic schemes for the hybridGEOTABS concept
